intended_use: continuous gamma-delta T-cell state-program usage scoring from raw UMI counts
limitations: GSE294268 contains AIM-selected stimulated cells and is not a population-prevalence cohort.
A substantial external reconstruction-error tail exceeds the Gray held-out reference.
Pooled allergic-versus-NonA effects are confounded by Experiment.
Rank-signature comparisons are baselines, not orthogonal functional validation.
Low external usage for a component is absence of support, not proof of biological absence.
PANGEA was inspected in notebooks 16-18 and is not an untouched final cohort.
PANGEA gamma-delta labels are expression-derived silver annotations, not receptor truth.
PANGEA exposes Series and Sample but no verified donor identifier; inference uses Series.
The PANGEA object contains no orthogonal protein or functional endpoint for this scorer.
Gray adult scRNA and Data S12 functional donors do not overlap; validation aligns 10 tissue x Vd contexts and cannot estimate paired donor-level correspondence.
P2-GzmB concordance is also recovered by the train-only rank-signature baseline; incremental cNMF value is not established unless the bootstrap delta excludes zero.
Data S12 provides Areg, GzmB and IFNg after PMA-ionomycin but no killing, CD107a, TNF or protein readout for every cNMF program.
GSE268991 has seven paired colorectal donors; cells are nested subsamples and donor is the inference unit.
GSE268991 supplies same-cell surface protein and independent TCR evidence but no GZMB, PRF1, CD107a, TNF, killing or degranulation endpoint.
The untouched GSE268991 evaluation is one-shot: failed hypotheses or transportability cannot trigger threshold or model tuning.

The locked GSE268991 all-cell population has a large reconstruction-error tail; high acceptance in TCR-confirmed gamma-delta cells is a post-hoc intended-population diagnostic and must be labelled as such.
not_intended_for: population-prevalence inference from AIM-selected GSE294268 cells

quality_gate.calibration_population: donor-held-out Gray cells from five K=8 outer folds

status: research-grade frozen scorer; untouched paired multimodal external validation completed; incremental value established=False; prospective cytotoxicity validation still required

validation_readout.disease_validation: not established; allergy is confounded with Experiment
validation_readout.external_GSE268991_evidence_tier: locked untouched final cohort; seven paired colorectal donors with raw-UMI GEX, same-cell CITE-seq ADT and independent gamma-delta TCR
validation_readout.external_GSE268991_incremental_value: mean donor ROC-AUC delta cNMF-minus-signature=-0.001638, 95% donor-bootstrap CI=[-0.06214, 0.04694], incremental value established=False
validation_readout.external_GSE268991_reconstruction_scope: locked all-cell Gray-q95 acceptance=0.509; post-hoc TCR-confirmed unambiguous gamma-delta target-cell acceptance=0.951. The latter diagnoses intended-population transportability but does not replace the locked all-cell result.
validation_readout.external_PANGEA_evidence_tier: atlas transportability and expression-derived silver-label association; not untouched or orthogonal functional validation
validation_readout.external_PANGEA_raw_UMI_projection: completed for 2107 gamma-delta cells across 120 Series after excluding GSE149356
validation_readout.external_paired_stimulation_validation: 15 component-contrast tests at within-family BH q<0.05 after Gray-q95 filtering
validation_readout.functional_rank_signature_baseline: P2-GzmB rank-signature rho=0.818; incremental cNMF value established=False
validation_readout.incremental_value_over_rank_signature: not established; under the same Gray-q95 paired-donor design, cNMF has 15/24 and the rank-signature baseline has 17/24 within-family BH q<0.05 tests
validation_readout.orthogonal_protein_or_functional_validat: Gray Data S12 independent-donor flow validation completed across 10 matched tissue x Vd contexts; P2-GzmB rho=0.818, permutation P=0.00645; zero donor overlap, so this is not donor-paired validation
